pieces.title: Navadvīpacandra Gosvāmī Vidyāratna (was in the record of Navadvīpacandra dāsa, disciple of Rādhāramaṇa-caraṇa dāsa)

fields.notes: A composer of padas; Padakalpataru no. 2961, on nāma-saṅkīrtana, is his. Taken out of the record #1020 (the disciple of Rādhāramaṇa-caraṇa dāsa, d. 1902), which mixed three Navadvīpacandras (11-11-2026).

fields.place: Navadvīpa (his descendants serve Sonār Gaurāṅga in Śrīvāsa's house)
fields.works: Vaiṣṇavācāra-darpaṇa; Vaiṣṇava-vrata-dina-nirṇaya; Aruṇodaya-vedhe Janmāṣṭamī-parityāgera vidhi; edited 33 chapters of the Śaṅkarācārya-vijaya (Asiatic Society, 1867)
fields.notes: A paṇḍita of Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu's family; author of the Vaiṣṇavācāra-darpaṇa and of works on the Vaiṣṇava vows; explained vaidhī and rāgānugā bhakti in simple Bengali. In 1867 the Asiatic Society of Bengal asked him to edit the Śaṅkarācārya-vijaya; he corrected 33 chapters and handed it to Jayanārāyaṇa Tarkapañcānana. His descendants serve Sonār Gaurāṅga and other Deities in Śrīvāsa's house at Navadvīpa. Taken out of the record #1020 (11-11-2026).
